description: For an order awaiting payment: files the payment intake (billing address, role, the wallet the buyer will send from, and acceptance of the terms, refund and privacy documents, and of Schedule C (Crypto Payments) of the Terms of Service with accept_terms, before any code is emailed). For a Ukrainian billing address, billing.region is required: the region's ISO 3166-2 code, e.g. UA-30. Texas sales tax applies. Unless the payment service has already verified the buyer's email, it mails a six-digit code to the HUMAN buyer's own inbox (the order's email), never to you: the person must give you the code for confirm_crypto_payment, and you cannot complete a crypto payment without it. Once a crypto payment starts, the card checkout link is withdrawn: one payment per order. A first crypto order is paid as usual and checked by a person before the report is released. Rails are the ones the payment service has on (get_order_status lists them; network fees are paid by the sender, and a rail whose fees are higher says so there). Nothing is charged here: the buyer sends the payment from their own wallet. Crypto is offered only on some orders (get_order_status carries a crypto block where it is); for any other order this tool answers that crypto is not offered for the order, and nothing changes.

accept.description: The buyer accepts the terms, the refund policy and the privacy policy for this payment, and this acknowledgment (hub-ack-2026-11-02-crypto): "I understand this is a paid engagement. After payment, an ARUON analyst checks the order and starts the report; the clock starts at our analyst's go-ahead, not at payment (the card charge or the USDC payment)."

accept_terms.description: Must be true: the buyer has read and accepts Schedule C (Crypto Payments) of ARUON's Terms of Service, version 2026-11-06.1: https://aruon.ai/terms-of-service#schedule-c. Required before the code is emailed and before any payment; a call without it is refused and nothing is filed.

phone.description: The buyer's phone. Required here when the order was placed without one.

name: start_crypto_payment
title: Pay an order by crypto instead of the card link
